markets.rules_primary: If Hyperscaler is said by any Nebius Group N.V. representative (including the operator of the call) during the next Nebius Group N.V. earnings call (including the Q+A), then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: Video of the Nebius Group N.V. earnings call will be primarily used to resolve the market; if a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, transcripts of the Nebius Group N.V. earnings call will be used according to the news publications listed in the contract.
